oracle: Dedicated Playwright-pinned Chromium 153 headless shell. All browser requests are blocked; setContent and the verified pinned inline Chart.js UMD source are used.

chart.tooltipConfiguration: No tooltip or legend options are supplied; resolved defaults are captured from the live Chart.js instance.

captureNotes.scope: Browser interaction oracle only. This fixture reports no native Android success or result.
captureNotes.gestures: Bar, blank/outside, and legend gestures use Playwright touchscreen.tap. Coordinates are CSS pixels computed from live Chart.js geometry and legend hit boxes.
captureNotes.eventRecording: Chart.js options.onClick records its real callback arguments. Canvas event listeners observe trusted browser events without preventing or changing them.
captureNotes.tooltip: The default Chart.js tooltip plugin is enabled with its stock options and callbacks; no mock plugin or programmatic active-element mutation is used.
captureNotes.comparison: Compare semantic states and event kind/indices. Native platform font metrics and raw touch event sequences can differ.
